# Neo Light's button badge and a hosted button render unreadable text

## Context

Emmy's camera shoots the catalog's light and dark tile pairs (#21933, #21942). It found two tiles with unreadable text and left them out of neomjs/pages#174:
- The light partner of the button tile: [frame](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/c692a88e02414bb2d188b5bdcefe318130411f1a/review-evidence/21936/button-base-14-light.jpg?raw=true).
- The dark functional host tile: [frame](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/c692a88e02414bb2d188b5bdcefe318130411f1a/review-evidence/21936/functional-hostComponent-14.jpg?raw=true).

Clio routed both to the tiles' builder. Neither fault is in the tiles. Both are in the source.

## The Problem

Measured on `dev` `3766834958` in Chromium, with the theme class swapped on the themed nodes:

```
examples/button/base, Neo Light:
  .neo-button-badge "Badge"  color rgb(0, 0, 0)  on  background-color rgb(0, 0, 0)
examples/functional/hostComponent, Dark:
  #myButtonModule keeps class neo-theme-neo-light, its text rgb(14, 15, 13) on the dark page
```

The first fault is engine-wide. Every button badge that reads the base badge tokens renders black on black in Neo Light: the default, primary and tertiary buttons.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/button/Base.css` colors `.neo-button-badge` from `--button-badge-background-color` and `--button-badge-color`. Primary and tertiary alias those two in the Neo themes.
- `resources/css/theme-neo-light/button/Base.css` sets both to `var(--sem-color-fg-neutral-contrast)`, which is black. The pair came in with #21575.
- `theme-neo-dark/button/Base.css` pairs `--sem-color-fg-neutral-contrast` with `--sem-color-fg-neutral-inverted`. In Neo Light, `inverted` is white (`theme-neo-light/Global.css`). Every classic theme also gives the badge's text a different color from its background.
- `examples/functional/hostComponent/Component.mjs` gives the hosted `Neo.button.Base` `theme: 'neo-theme-neo-light'`, which has been there since July 2025 (#7055). A component's own theme class wins over the page's, so the button never follows a dark theme.

## The Fix

1. In `resources/css/theme-neo-light/button/Base.css`, set `--button-badge-color: var(--sem-color-fg-neutral-inverted)`.
2. In `examples/functional/hostComponent/Component.mjs`, drop the `theme` line so the button inherits the page's theme.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] In Neo Light, a button badge reads white on black. A component-tier spec asserts it: red on `dev`, green at the head.
- [ ] The hosted button in `examples/functional/hostComponent` carries no theme class of its own and reads light on a dark page.
- [ ] The pull request carries before and after frames of both.
- [ ] No cover in the pull request. Once it merges, the two tiles rejoin the #21942 backfill.

## Out of Scope

The secondary and ghost badges, which the Neo themes set to transparent, are left as they are and were not measured here. Classic themes already pair their badge colors.
